note: Small committed summary only. Full run directories, SQLite files, caches and raw logs remain local and git-ignored.

execution_context.code_commit_under_test: cd3a452 (transport repair) plus the decision-diagnostics working tree described in README
execution_context.rerun_policy: The agent arm ran exactly once at this code version. No best-of selection, no manual action rewriting.
execution_context.why_more_than_one_version: Each earlier version exposed a distinct defect that was fixed and offline-tested before the next single real run. Each run is reported separately; none was discarded or rerun for a better number.

frozen_settings.roles: The model only selects the next action; RDKit performs every deterministic molecular edit and property calculation.

connectivity_gate.gate_selection: The newest dated connectivity summary is used, so a fresh acceptance run supersedes an older gate.

decision_trace.interpretation: The agent evaluated the parent, proposed a batch, screened it, executed one edit, compared parent and child, and on an unsupported result switched strategy and proposed a second batch. It then found a qualifying candidate and stopped.

interpretation_limits: One parent, one model run and a constrained one-hop catalogue: this is a mechanism check, not a benchmark.
No statistical superiority over the rule arm is claimed from a single run each.
The qualifying molecule is supported by a fixed arithmetic threshold, not by docking or biological validation.
Reachability audit scores were computed separately and never passed to either policy.
A proposed option is never counted as an actual edit, and a schema rejection is never counted as a network failure.
Total-score changes must not be extrapolated to individual property improvements.
The agent arm used 8 of 10 new-structure evaluations; the rule arm used all 10.
Token totals come from provider usage fields; monetary cost is unavailable.
next_steps: Repeat this frozen diagnostic on 2-3 parents with at most 3 repeats each to check stability before any larger claim.
Keep the connectivity gate mandatory for every real agent arm.
Do not extend to full 3D, docking, or n=20 yet.
